items.title: 5 day forecast updated as of 13 October 2026 10:23pm
items.description:
##Today##

Sunny spells and isolated showers, quite breezy. Dry and clear overnight.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 10°C and max. air temperature 15°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

0-2


##Wind Speed##

22


##Wind Direction##

SW


##Wind##

West or SW 20, occasionally 25 with gusts 35-40, then decreasing 10-15 late in day/ at first overnight, 15-20 in places. Backing South or SW 15-20 later in night, 20-25 in places.


##Visibility##

Good.


##Comments##

Strong winds. Coastal overtopping in places at high tide, approx. 1.45pm.


##Tomorrow##

Dry and bright, but quite windy, then rain late in night.


##Temperature##

Min. air temperature 13°C and max. air temperature 16°C


##Rainfall (mm):##

1-3 later.


##Wind Speed##

30


##Wind Direction##

S


##Wind##

South or SW 15-20, 20-25 in places, soon increasing 25-30 gusts 40, and possibly 35 gusts 45-50 in a few spots later in day/ overnight.


##Visibility##

Mostly good, possibly moderate in rain later. Hill fog at times.


##Comments##

Strong winds, possibly touching gale force in places. Coastal overtopping possible in places at high tide (approx. 14:17 pm and 02:27 am).


##Thursday, 15 October 2026##

Rain, heavy at times, but the strong winds easing. Rain clearing during afternoon or evening, then clear overnight.


##Temperature##

##Wind Speed##

##Wind##

##Visibility##

Moderate at times in rain, then good. Hill fog at first.


##Comments##

Strong winds at first, possibly touching gale force in places. Heavy rain.
